notes: Published a test release to verify the repaired main launcher update detection from version 0.2.51.
changelog: v0.2.52 - Test release for end-to-end validation of the repaired main launcher update detection, multi-endpoint GitHub metadata lookup, cache bypass, manual Check Again action, download, and installation flow.

v0.2.51 - Fixed the main launcher update detection by checking multiple independent GitHub endpoints, disabling metadata caching, selecting the highest returned version, preventing duplicate checks, and adding a manual Check Again button.

v0.2.50 - Fixed clipped and missing Optimization card buttons, added a live progress window with current action, percentage, detailed log, completion and error states, improved Windows 10 apply/restore reporting, and introduced a safe Windows 11 optimization profile with backup and restore support.

v0.2.49 - Restored automatic updating in the new Suite launcher with an Install button, confirmation dialog, download progress, safe file replacement, restart, download-page fallback, and visible error handling.

v0.2.48 - Made the Windows 10 XP optimization controls permanently visible, added separate Apply XP Optimization and Restore Settings buttons, removed the clipped card action, and added Test-Optimization-Windows10.bat for direct testing.

v0.2.47 - Added the reversible Windows 10 optimization profile for 2/4 GB RAM, restore-point and settings backup support, bundled Open-Shell 4.4.198 locally, and added the Windows XP Luna Start menu design without a separate download.
v0.2.46 - Moved update checking and history to the Suite start screen, reused the result when WGA launches, and added separate WGA-style Optimization and Network Monitoring interface modules.
v0.2.45 - Added a new WinSys Guardian Suite launcher before the existing WGA loader with dedicated WGA, Optimization, and Network Monitoring module cards.
v0.2.44 - Rebuilt the update package from the corrected UTF-8 source so the Automatic Installer and Visual Studio entries show normal Bulgarian text instead of mojibake in the released EXE.

v0.2.43 - Added a full local icon refresh with dedicated card and dashboard icons, made the Language menu visible from the main navigation and dashboard quick actions, compacted the sidebar so all menus fit, and cleaned the Language and Nexus Admin cards for a simpler layout.

v0.2.42 - Restored the missing download button in the Install Software compact resources card, centered it without shifting the resource and work-mode information, and kept its enabled state synchronized with missing installer packages.

v0.2.41 - Updated the USB installer package with a drive-relative Start WGA.cmd and start.bat launcher that searches the installed USB flash/HDD/SSD for WGA.exe, kept the setup package clean without bundling the Installers folder, and refined the top update-history button plus Automatic Installer centering.

v0.2.40 - Fixed the Dashboard return flow so every Dashboard button forces a clean redraw, added diagnostics for blank dashboard states, stabilized dashboard rendering against background refresh races, restored Bulgarian text encoding, cleaned and compacted Activation, Install Software, Office Install Center, Office Online God Mode, Archive, and Automatic Installer menus, centered the Automatic Installer, and updated the build package to include all visual assets.

v0.2.39 - Refined the Home dashboard again with a cleaner centered sidebar brand block, restored the original Home navigation button, improved the framed dashboard panels, fixed mouse-wheel scrolling inside the System Status and Automatic Installer cards, enabled working installer checkboxes with installed-item protection, and switched the component status panel to more honest real checks for activation, runtime, security, and storage components.

v0.2.38 - Reworked the Home dashboard closer to the reference mockup with a stronger left navigation, live clock footer, richer status banner, fuller metric cards, icon-led system panels, and a denser automatic installer preview so the main screen finally matches the generated concept much more directly.

v0.2.37 - Added the missing dashboard icon system and wired the generated icon sheet into the redesigned Home screen so the sidebar, status panels, metric cards, and quick actions now carry real visual icons closer to the reference design.

v0.2.36 - Rebuilt the Home screen into a real dashboard layout closer to the concept image: dedicated status banner, metric cards, structured system panels, automatic installer preview, component status list, quick actions, and persistent sidebar navigation while keeping the old tools behind the new design.

v0.2.35 - Added a stronger dashboard redesign closer to the new concept image: persistent sidebar navigation, active section highlighting, top overview cards, richer status panels, and a more structured control-center layout while keeping the old functionality.
v0.2.34 - Refreshed the main WGA interface with a new premium cyber-admin visual style: updated header, sidebar, cards, badges, panels, and button palette to match the new dashboard concept.
v0.2.33 - Added clear Automatic Installer error reporting so the menu no longer stays blank when the software scan fails and now shows whether the task list is empty or a runtime check crashed.
v0.2.32 - Fixed the Automatic Installer properly by removing duplicated broken code paths and restoring one working flow for software scanning, checklist rendering, and installation selection.
v0.2.31 - Fixed the Automatic Installer loading screen after the responsive changes by restoring valid wrap-size handling so the software scan and checklist render again.
v0.2.30 - Fixed the Automatic Installer page after the responsive layout update by restoring the missing local wrap-size variables that blocked the menu from rendering.
v0.2.29 - Improved responsive scaling by adapting panel widths, card sizes, button sizes, wrap lengths, and column counts to different monitor resolutions and DPI settings.
v0.2.28 - Fixed the Automatic Installer page so it no longer stays empty when software-status checks fail or when the list is reopened after the first scan.
v0.2.27 - Added automatic DPI-aware resizing for the splash screen, main window, and card layout so the interface stays clear on different monitor sizes and scaling modes.
v0.2.26 - Fixed online Office installation by switching from invalid winget package IDs to Microsoft Office Deployment Tool with proper product IDs and installed-version detection.
v0.2.25 - Fixed missing buttons in Office Install Center and Secret Install by increasing card height and using more compact text wrapping for those menus.
v0.2.24 - Fixed the Nexus Admin create/delete user cards so their buttons stay visible and tightened the local user create/delete input handling.
v0.2.23 - Fixed the Nexus Admin card layout and moved all program selection flow into the Automatic Installer, removing the separate selector entry points.
v0.2.22 - Adjusted the Office Deployment Center layout so the long cards on page 4 have enough height and wider text wrapping.
v0.2.21 - Fixed the Office Install Center card layout so the last two boxes keep the same button area and match the other cards.
v0.2.20 - Added a full Windows 10 activation menu with save, show, clear, and run actions, matching the Windows 11 workflow.
v0.2.19 - Fixed product key entry so Windows 11 and Office key dialogs switch to English keyboard layout and normalize Cyrillic input automatically.
v0.2.18 - Reworked the desktop icons option so it enables the real Windows desktop icons for This PC, Network, Control Panel, and User Files with a visible progress window.
v0.2.17 - Fixed the desktop icons button so it now creates working WGA shortcuts on the desktop, including direct menu shortcuts.
v0.2.16 - Removed the password prompt from the Windows 11 activation menu and kept the updated version detection fix.
v0.2.15 - Fixed repeated update notifications after updating by syncing and reading the correct version file from the installed build.
v0.2.14 - Improved online package downloads so extraction shows live progress and the next package starts visibly after the current one finishes.
v0.2.13 - Added a faster startup USB check and blocked the installer before opening when no allowed USB device is found.
v0.2.12 - Restricted setup to USB storage only and blocked all local installations.
v0.2.11 - Restricted setup to USB flash drives and external SSD devices only.
v0.2.10 - Fixed the USB-only setup flow so the installer no longer falls back to a remembered C drive path.
v0.2.9 - Added a USB-only setup package with launcher, autorun files, and drive-root preparation for external media.
v0.2.8 - Added a loading screen for software checks and expanded the installer menu with all detected local tools.
v0.2.7 - Expanded the program selector, improved installed software detection, and fixed Adobe Reader replacement flow.
v0.2.6 - Added install flow checks for existing software, optional removal, and clearer progress steps.
v0.2.5 - Added a new separate program selector window with checkboxes for bulk installation.
v0.2.4 - Fixed portable Installers folder creation next to WGA.exe on flash drives.
v0.2.3 - Fixed online package downloads so they continue after closing the progress window and show extraction progress.
v0.2.2 - Fixed installer manifest reading with UTF-8 BOM and old portable manifest fallback.
v0.2.1 - Fixed resource manifest selection so online downloads work after updating from older portable builds.
v0.2.0 - Added online installer resources from networkbgs.com with speed, ETA, package count, and SHA256 verification.
v0.1.9 - Added cache-busting update metadata checks to prevent stale GitHub raw responses.
v0.1.8 - Switched update metadata and package downloads to refs/heads/main to avoid stale GitHub raw cache.
v0.1.7 - Fixed automatic updater download path and added WGA-update.log diagnostics.
v0.1.6 - Added automatic installer menu with checkboxes and one-click sequential installation.
v0.1.5 - Added update history button and popup notification for available updates.
v0.1.4 - Added automatic update installer with download, file replacement, and restart.
v0.1.3 - Added Bulgarian update messages and clearer GitHub raw diagnostics.
v0.1.2 - Added language status panel, Adobe Reader version check, resource manager, icon, and UI fixes.
